facts.fact: Afcom, per its own service page, operates a carrier-neutral data centre in Freetown where customers can rent rack, cage or space for their own servers or buy its cloud solution.
Afcom describes its Sierra Leone data center as a Tier III facility, concurrently maintainable, in its own words.

SLE.note: The page says Afcom owns the facility but not whether Afcom is nationally owned.
Nothing stated about government backup sites.
